elements.name: Open a panel compacted by a narrow application window

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Manage ribbon displayed
the Insert panel displays its commands directly at the wider window size
the user narrows the application window until Insert becomes a compact panel button
the Manage tab remains active
the part remains visible
the user clicks the compact Insert panel button
a temporary Insert panel opens below the ribbon with its commands
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary panel closes and the compact Insert button remains visible
the user maximizes the application window
the Insert commands appear directly in the ribbon again
the part remains visible

elements.name: Select a ribbon tab from the overflow menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Manage ribbon visible
the application window is narrow enough that View is outside the visible tab row
the user clicks the ribbon tab overflow control
a menu lists the tabs that do not fit in the row, including View
the user selects View from the overflow menu
the menu closes and the View command groups replace the Manage command groups
View remains outside the visible tab row at this window width
the user maximizes the application window
View is visible and active in the tab row
its command groups and the part remain visible

elements.name: Dismiss tab overflow without changing the active ribbon

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon displayed
View is active but outside the visible tab row because the window is narrow
the user opens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the user presses Escape
the overflow menu closes
the View command groups remain displayed
the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the user clicks the overflow control again
the overflow menu closes and the View command groups remain displayed
the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu
the user clicks the visible Tools tab
the overflow menu closes
Tools becomes active and its command groups replace the View groups
the part remains visible

elements.name: Select an overflowed tab while the ribbon is minimized to tabs

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with Tools active in tabs-only ribbon display
the narrow application window places View in the tab overflow menu
the user opens the tab overflow menu and selects View
the overflow menu closes
no temporary ribbon command panel opens
the part remains visible
the user maximizes the application window
View is visible as the active tab
the ribbon remains in tabs-only display

elements.name: Switch between panels compacted by a narrow window

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full View ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Appearance and Windows as compact panel buttons
the user clicks the Appearance panel button
the temporary Appearance panel opens below the ribbon
the user clicks the Windows panel button
the Appearance panel closes and the temporary Windows panel opens
the user clicks the Windows panel button again
the Windows panel remains open
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Windows panel closes
the part remains visible

elements.name: Close a width-compacted panel by switching ribbon tabs

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full View ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Windows as a compact panel button
the temporary Windows panel is open
the user selects the visible Tools tab
the Windows panel closes
the Tools ribbon groups are displayed
the user selects View from the tab overflow menu
the View ribbon groups are displayed
the temporary Windows panel remains closed
the part remains visible

elements.name: Launch document settings from a width-compacted ribbon panel

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Options as a compact panel button
the user opens the Options panel
the user selects Document Settings
the Document Settings dialog opens for the active part
the user closes the dialog without changing settings
the dialog and temporary Options panel are closed
the Tools ribbon and part remain visible

elements.name: Open Document Settings from the full Tools ribbon

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open with the full Tools ribbon displayed in the MCAD Software
the user selects Document Settings
the active part's Document Settings dialog opens
the dialog shows Standard, Units, Sketch, Modeling, Bill of Materials and Default Tolerance tabs
Standard is the selected tab
Close is available while Cancel and Apply are unavailable
the user closes the dialog without changing settings
the dialog closes
the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible

elements.name: Maximize while a width-compacted panel is open

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Modify as a compact panel button
the temporary Modify panel is open
the user maximizes the application window
the temporary Modify panel closes
the Modify commands are displayed directly in the ribbon
the part remains visible
